blind.description: A stylized stone wall section featuring a pointed masonry archway fitted with a wooden portcullis. The portcullis is constructed from a crosshatched wooden lattice with round iron rivets at the intersections and pointed iron-capped spikes at the bottom. The stone blocks have rounded, hand-painted stylized textures in varying shades of grey, tan, and slate, with green moss patches near the base. Surfaces are solid, clean, and continuous with no floating, melted, or broken fragments.
blind.from_above: A straight horizontal row of eight rounded rectangular coping stones capping a thick wall, casting a shadow that shows the grid pattern of the portcullis underneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 5 feet tall (slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 7 to 8 feet wide (about 1.3 to 1.4 times the figure's height).
